verdicts.note: Prompt does not name review methods, hint at planted problems, or give problem count. It asks for a general review fitting existing contracts, targets, and incident experience.
Clear instructions: review the design document and surrounding context, write to REVIEW.md, output JSON findings with location, severity, issue, fix.

Requires cross-referencing multiple documents (design, architecture, data classification, traffic/SLOs, incident). Quick skim would miss URL egress, data policy violations, tenant isolation, retention policy contradictions.
All 7 key items have clear evidence in fixture: design contradicts policies in context files (data classification, traffic/SLOs) or misses protections shown in incident report.
No comments, tests, or file names point at specific problems. Context files contain policies but don't highlight contradictions explicitly.
